categories.notes: 8% contingency on subtotal. Gutted homes carry higher risk of hidden issues behind remaining framing and in slab plumbing.

redFlags: House is fully gutted to studs — likely severe flood damage (consistent with Houston-area flood events)
Potential mold remediation needed on remaining framing — dark staining visible on wood studs
Roof age unknown — could need replacement during rehab
Original electrical and plumbing systems may not meet current code upon rebuild
Flood zone risk — check FEMA flood maps and insurance requirements before investing
assumptions: Approximately 1,400 sq ft single-story home based on exterior dimensions
3 bedroom / 2 bathroom layout assumed based on house size and framing visible
Concrete slab foundation — no basement or crawlspace
Home was gutted due to flood damage — drywall removed to studs throughout
All interior finishes, fixtures, appliances, and cabinetry need full replacement
Framing is assumed to be structurally sound and reusable (no visible rot or termite damage)
Mold remediation may be needed but not included as a separate line item — would add $2,000-$5,000 if required
HVAC system assumed non-functional or removed
Pricing based on nationwide average contractor rates for mid-size US cities
